{{Quote|Once we hunted goblins bad<br />''"''Among trees of Garban's land;<br />''"''They killed and ate Ch'irrk Felt's kin,<br />''"''And mighty anger boiled within!|Opening stanza of the "Ballad of Shan'Gredor"|<ref name="COTG ">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>}}
'''Ch'irrk Felt''' was a legendary [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] who featured in the epic poem, "[[The Ballad of Shan'Gredor]]." According to the poem, [[danchaf]]&mdash;also known as tree goblins&mdash;[[Death/Legends|killed]] and ate Felt's relatives, an indignity that spurred Felt's retaliation: a trap of pots, pans, and [[phospowder]]. The danchaf tripped the trap and were deafened by it. Disoriented, the danchaf were little match for Felt and his minions, who attacked from the underbrush of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garban]] upon Felt's battle cry. In the end, the poem claimed, twenty danchaf were killed and only three Jenets died.<ref name="COTG " />
